law.law: Constitution of the Co-operative Republic of Guyana, Article 4 and Second Schedule

meta.name: Guyana
note: The Schedule's drawing is only illustrative, and it gives no sizes. Its 'colour proportions' (printed as green 50, gold 24, white 67, black 1 in the Laws of Guyana, L.R.O. 1/2012) omit red and can't be built into this geometry, so they aren't used.

The edging width of 1 on a hoist of 30 is from Hemendra Bhola's approximate sheet on FOTW, not the law. Christopher Southworth recalled 3/50 of the width from a 1966 brochure he couldn't recheck. That is set aside because Bhola worked from the Constitution Amendment Act, a College of Arms scan and flags, and found the edgings narrower than usually drawn.
The colors are the Album des Pavillons 2023 as FOTW reports it. FOTW records that no official shades exist, and that Bhola and Horvath prefer darker ones, Pantone 200 C, 123 C and 356 C.
